docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Gundert’s Malayalam–English dictionary, the first great dictionary of Malayalam, with its quotations from the old poets and the etymologies (Mangalore, 1871). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: A Malayalam and English dictionary · Gundert, Hermann, 1814-1893 · 1871, 222 scanned pages. Published 1871; Hermann Gundert died 1893; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
